purpose: Test the tempting repair: drop one of the two rank-3-switch conflicts so the global problem becomes ordinary bipartite matching, then attach a local weighted-matching gadget whose cost is zero on all five original switch states and strictly positive on the one extra relaxed state. Prove that no terminal valuation in the valuated-delta-matroid class can implement this penalty profile.

local_switch.relaxation: Drop the {L,M} conflict and keep only {M,R}. The relaxed feasible states are exact_states plus {L,M}.
local_switch.desired_min_cost: phi(X)=0 for every exact state, phi({L,M})=lambda>0; states containing {M,R} are infeasible.
local_switch.equivalent_max_valuation: delta=-phi on the relaxed support, so delta=0 on the five exact states and delta({L,M})=-lambda.

source_facts.source: K. Murota, Characterizing a Valuated Delta-matroid as a Family of Delta-matroids, JORSJ 40(4), 1997
source_facts.fact: For an even valuated delta-matroid, for every linear weighting p the maximizers of delta+p form the feasible-set family of a delta-matroid. In particular p=0 forces the maximizer family itself to be a delta-matroid.

source_facts.source: K. Takazawa, Optimal Matching Forests and Valuated Delta-Matroids, SIAM J. Discrete Math. 28(1), 2014
source_facts.fact: Weighted matching forests induce a valuated delta-matroid; the induced delta-matroid need not be even. Ordinary weighted matching terminal-set valuations are the classical even special case.

theorem.name: NO_LOCAL_VALUATED_MATCHING_GADGET_FOR_SINGLE_RANK3_SWITCH_PENALTY
theorem.statement: For every lambda>0, the desired local max-valuation delta cannot be a valuated delta-matroid (nor a weighted-matching/matching-forest terminal valuation satisfying the same maximizer-delta property).
proof: At zero external linear weighting p=0, the maximizers of delta are exactly the five zero-penalty exact states R={empty,{L},{M},{R},{L,R}}.
R is not a delta-matroid. Take X={L,R}, Y={M}, and u=M in X symmetric-difference Y. For v=M,L,R respectively, X symmetric-difference {u,v} is {L,M,R}, {M,R}, or {L,M}; none belongs to R.
Therefore the symmetric-exchange axiom fails for the maximizer family.
The maximizer characterization of valuated delta-matroids is violated already at p=0. Hence no valuation in that class realizes the requested local penalty profile.

killed: Drop one P3 conflict, solve the resulting two-partition-matroid matching, and encode the missing conflict by a local weighted-matching terminal gadget with zero cost on all exact states and positive cost only on {L,M}.
Any equivalent local terminal-cost construction whose value function is a valuated delta-matroid and whose optimum states are exactly the five rank-3-switch states.
not_killed: A genuinely nonlocal weighted construction coupling several rank-3 switches simultaneously without exposing the five-state relation as one terminal valuation.
An augmentation algorithm outside the valuated-delta-matroid/matching-gadget model.
Global algebraic cancellation where locally forbidden states survive and cancel only after combining many variables.

next_target.name: E8_NONLOCAL_SWITCH_AUGMENTATION_OR_GLOBAL_CANCELLATION_V2_9
next_target.directive: Do not retry additive local penalties or local weighted matching gadgets. Search for a polynomially discoverable global augmenting structure that couples multiple P3 switches, or a global cancellation identity in which locally inconsistent states may survive transiently but cancel exactly without exponential state expansion.
success_obligations: no exponential branching, boundary-state tensor product, character enumeration, or hidden oracle
